`motion.mp4` is a generated 3-second, 640 × 360, 30 fps H.264 test pattern (no personal footage). See the main README for its FFmpeg generation command.

`example-sony.ARW` is an optional, ignored upstream LibRaw-Wasm fixture. See the main README for its download command. It was present during the initial end-to-end RAW verification; it is not served as a public asset.
